equipment_failure.narration.1: Crackle! A solar panel is throwing sparks.
equipment_failure.narration.2: Machines get tired out here, Commander, and fixing them early is part of the job.
equipment_failure.narration.flicker: That flicker from Sol 5 is back, and it’s bigger!
equipment_failure.dialogue.kai: Uh-oh, that panel is making sparks! I can fix it, but it takes power and time.
equipment_failure.cargo.spare_parts: Good thing we packed spare parts!
equipment_failure.question: How do we fix it?
equipment_failure.A.label: Full repair
equipment_failure.B.label: Quick patch
equipment_failure.C.label: Switch to backup panels
equipment_failure.A.after: Good as new! The repair took a lot of power, but now the panel is safe.
equipment_failure.B.after: A quick patch saved power, but patches don’t always hold. Let’s keep an eye on it.
equipment_failure.C.after: The backup panels work, but they make a little less power from now on.
equipment_failure.classroom: What can happen when we delay a repair?
minigame.repair_wires.hint: Choose a wire end, then its matching symbol. Connect all three pairs.
minigame.repair_wires.done: The wires are connected. You earned a small power bonus.
